gist.summary: Added @xiaotian1171’s Echo Island to the video_audio app catalog and README showcase. The static Hugging Face Space turns a character idea into an illustrated story and voice note; users can duplicate it and sign in with their own Pollen. Narration falls back when timestamped voice is unavailable.

image.prompt: On a cozy pixel-art island, Polli wears tiny storyteller glasses and helps arrange illustrated story pages beside a glowing voice-note recorder, with flowers and code-plants along the shore. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, strictly pixel art, never realistic, against a prominent lime green (#ecf874) and soft pastel gradient background with dark purple (#110518) outlines — cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
